one_liner: Devin has a REST v3 API authenticated with static cog_ service-user keys or personal access tokens. It likely has an official MCP, but the pages don't show one, and they don't settle which plan includes API access.
auth_notes: Service user keys and personal access tokens use the cog_ prefix and are sent as a Bearer token. The authorization-code flow on the outposts partners page needs a Cognition-configured callback allowlist and only returns an outpost worker token, so it is not general third-party OAuth. Legacy v1/v2 keys still work but are not recommended.
access_notes: The pages don't say whether the Free plan includes API access. The quickstarts target Teams and Enterprise orgs with service users. Teams or Enterprise is the most defensible reading, but this is uncertain.
blocker_notes: API access probably needs a Teams or Enterprise plan, though the pages don't confirm this. Credentials are static and per org or user, so each customer must create a service user key or PAT. Enterprise-scope endpoints are limited to enterprise customers.
